summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Google Maps integration for FeGrro construction hours app. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend verification confirmed map displays correctly with dark theme, all 4 construction sites appear as pins, and info windows show site details with assigned employees.

issues: Info window has light background (Google Maps default) - minor contrast with dark theme app. This is expected Google Maps behavior.

critical_code_review_comments: Google Maps integration using @react-google-maps/api is well implemented
Dark theme map styling uses custom styles array with appropriate colors
Geocoding endpoint properly calls Google Maps Geocoding API
Info window correctly displays site name, address, and assigned employees
Note: google.maps.Marker is deprecated (console warning) - consider migrating to AdvancedMarkerElement in future
seed_data_creation: None - all 4 sites already have coordinates set
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Maps integration fully working. Map displays in Budowy tab with dark theme styling. All 4 construction sites (SASINO, ŁEBA ERBUD, BAUHAUS, Test Budowa) have coordinates and appear as pins. Clicking pins shows info window with site name, address, and assigned employees. Geocoding endpoint at GET /api/geocode?address=X returns lat/lng coordinates. Sites without location would show address input + 'Ustaw' button, but currently all sites have coordinates. Note: google.maps.Marker deprecation warning in console - not blocking, but consider future migration to AdvancedMarkerElement.

features: Map auto-fits to show all pins

geocoding.notes: Used for setting location via address input

google_maps_notes: Using @react-google-maps/api library. API key set in frontend/.env (REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY) and backend/.env (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY). Map uses custom dark theme styles. Markers use deprecated google.maps.Marker (console warning) but still functional.
